title: Approvals inbox and Approval Requests list show the flow and step labels in English under zh-CN, although the app's pack translates them
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 5 Setup (report comment 6442758420 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D5; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-ptkrz3` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/5-setup/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

Switch the user menu to 中文（中国）. As the sales manager open 待我审批; as the admin open Setup → 审批申请. Both read **"Large Deal Approval"** / **"Sales Manager Review"**, and the record's object reads "Opportunity", not 商机 (`53-zh-mgr-01-approvals-inbox.png`, `52-zh-09-setup-approval-requests.png`).

HotCRM's zh-CN pack carries `flows.opportunity_approval.label` 大额商机审批 and `approvals.manager_review.label` 销售经理审核 (`src/sales/translations/zh-CN/app.ts` in objectstack-ai/hotcrm), and the rest of the app — nav, dashboards, the record page — renders the pack.

**Who loses:** an approver in a zh-CN org reads the one screen they act from in English.

## Expected

The inbox and the `sys_approval_request` list resolve the flow label, the step label and the object label through the same translation lookup the app's own pages use.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "approval inbox flow label step label not translated zh-CN": 25 hits, the closest #26452 (closed, `/forms` select options), #26170 (open, hook refusal text has no key), #25802/#26108 (open, invitation mail role). None is the approvals surfaces.

**Reader who acts:** the console approvals inbox owner (`domain:ui`, `area:i18n`).
